_comment: Static SYCL placement prediction for the qwen4exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q8_0) graph, derived at fefb92980. Read by scripts/parse-sycl-sched-census.py --prediction; the reasoning and the inventory live in docs/backend/sycl-qwen4exp-op-census.md. Rules are matched in order, first match wins: op is compared at the printer's %10.10s width, name and src0 are regexes over the %20.20s-truncated node and src[0] names. 'count' is the predicted node count per graph (n_tokens 1 and 512 alike) where it is exact. Line numbers are ggml/src/ggml-sycl/ggml-sycl.cpp unless a file is named.

rules.cite: input layer is the CPU device's buft list (src/llama-model.cpp:2338), whose first entry is the first GPU's host buffer type, ahead of the CPU buffer (make_cpu_buft_list, :1765-1777); the scheduler gives the gather the backend of that SYCL_Host buffer, so SYCL0 runs it -- measured on the B70 Mistral control (token_embd.weight [SYCL0]). Suspect; if verified zero-copy, not sanctioned (ruling 2026-09-27, doc P8, llama.cpp-lah5, which verifies the executor first -- the backend label is not the executor); after the fix this rule expects CPU

same input-layer buft list as IN-TOK-EMBD (per_layer_token_embd is LLM_TENSOR_LAYER_INPUT, src/llama-arch.cpp:915), so the 50.66 GiB PLE table would sit in a SYCL_Host pinned buffer and SYCL0 would gather from it; the storage-tier design (llama.cpp-th32) intends CPU/SSD. Predicted from the Mistral token gather, not measured; suspect; if verified zero-copy, not sanctioned (doc P8, llama.cpp-lah5)
